seed: Recordings and sounds go into the Library without going onto the timeline (video.html, onboarding step 2, Fill the Library: Import, drag and drop onto the panel). File > Import Media (Shift Command I) puts files on the shelf and opens the Library to show them; a file let go on the shelf becomes a tile there and lands nowhere else; the Library header's plus has Import Media too; then a tile dragged onto the empty Audio track lands there (step 3, Drop a first clip). At Next defaults, no flag set, the Library hidden as a new install has it.

steps.note: An eight second screen recording on V1, the Audio track empty, and the Library hidden, as it is on a new install

steps.comment: Shift Command I, the mock's File row, with no marquee up so the key is Import rather than Invert Selection.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: File > Import Media put b-roll.mp4 on the Library shelf and nowhere else. The Library, hidden a moment ago, is open on Media with the new tile in view, and the timeline still holds one clip
THE SECOND TEST: music from the Finder held over the Library. The shelf wears the accent ring that says it will keep it; the rest of the panel stays quiet

steps.says: Sample Music.m4a is in the Library

steps.note: Let go, the music is a tile on the shelf and not a clip on any track
THE THIRD TEST: the music tile dragged onto the empty Audio track landed there one second in, the mock's step 3
THE FOURTH TEST: the plus on the Library header has Import Media. Importing the music a second time keeps one tile and says it is already there
